inventory.exit_criteria: Record actual input paths, source hashes, current code evidence and one next stage. Catalog status is not project progress.

ui-menu.exit_criteria: Rust menu/state and ABI work through the Qt host; compare against the selected reference; record screenshots, lifecycle checks and disabled unsupported commands.

read_if.when: Recovering dimensions/control identity absent from screenshot and spec

ui-viewports.exit_criteria: Live FreeCAD views preserve camera, model selection and edit behavior; prove view arrangement with runtime evidence. A painted mockup is insufficient.

User explicitly requests a recovered VB6 listing

native-mapping.exit_criteria: Selected procedure has source/hash/VA, exact mapping status, separate behavioral confidence, bounded evidence and unresolved questions recorded for Rust implementation.

Working on Clayoo/SubD, distinct from T-Splines

feature-port.exit_criteria: Resolve exact ID with feature command, then read its returned spec and source manual page. Validate defaults, units, geometry and applicable preview/commit/cancel/history/undo/save behavior.

read_if.when: Checking the previously configured local build; inspect cache values, do not assume paths are valid

build-validation.exit_criteria: Actual Rust checks, C++ compile/link, module load and UI/lifecycle checks succeed with recorded commands, logs, build path and screenshots. Build presence alone is insufficient.
